OpenAI.headline: OpenAI faces legal challenges and revenue estimate cut.

bullets.text: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol promotional pricing is available at least through November 21, 2026.

Anthropic.headline: Anthropic expands Claude's capabilities and workforce changes.

bullets.text: Anthropic is designing more efficient quantum circuits with its Claude AI.
